R1   1  Kvit Notes
R2   2
R3   3 [![CI](https://github.com/kvit-s/kvit-notes/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.>
R4   4 [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kvit-s/kvit-note>
R5   5 [![License: MPL-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MPL--2.0-blue)](L>
R6   6
R7   7 Kvit Notes is a native markdown block editor and notes app: your notes are
R8   8 plain `.md` files on disk, shown fully rendered, with the raw syntax of a
R9   9 span revealed only while your cursor is inside it.
R10  10
R11  11 ![The three-pane shell: live-preview editing with inline math, a callout, a>
R12  12
R13  13 **[See it working](gallery.md)**: fourteen short clips of the real
R14  14 application, one per feature, with a paragraph on each.
R15  15
R16  16 ## Download
R17  17
R18  18 | Platform | Install |
R19  19 |---|---|
R20  20 | Linux | [AppImage](https://github.com/kvit-s/kvit-notes/releases/latest) >
